SELECT m.MATERIAL_ID, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP, m.PACK_SZ, x.NDC, (SELECT STRING_AGG(PLANT_ID, ',') FROM dbo.PLANT_MATERIAL pm WHERE pm.MATERIAL_ID=m.MATERIAL_ID) plants FROM dbo.MATERIAL m LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL_NDC_XREF x ON x.MATERIAL_ID=m.MATERIAL_ID WHERE m.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','FILL-1003','FILL-2001','FILL-2002','CMP-510')

SELECT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, CHILD_MATERIAL_ID, QTY_PER, EFF_FROM, EFF_TO FROM dbo.BOM WHERE PARENT_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002','FILL-1001','FILL-1002','FILL-1003','FILL-2001','FILL-2002') ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT i.DC_ID, i.MATERIAL_ID, i.SNAPSHOT_DT, i.ON_HAND_UNITS, i.SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV i WHERE i.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002') AND i.SNAPSHOT_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) FROM dbo.DC_INV i2 WHERE i2.DC_ID=i.DC_ID AND i2.MATERIAL_ID=i.MATERIAL_ID) ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, COUNT(*) n, SUM(UNITS) units, MIN(SHIP_DT) mn, MAX(SHIP_DT) mx FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002') AND SHIP_DT > DATEADD(week,-13,'2026-09-30') GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DC_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT >= '2026-07-01' ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.MATERIAL_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.REGION, SUM(CASE WHEN SHIP_DT < '2026-08-15' AND SHIP_DT >= '2026-05-16' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) base_13wk_before, SUM(CASE WHEN SHIP_DT >= '2026-08-15' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) since_aug15, SUM(CASE WHEN SHIP_DT >= '2026-07-02' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) last13wk FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP s JOIN dbo.WHSLR w ON w.WHSLR_ID=s.WHSLR_ID WHERE s.DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND s.MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') GROUP BY s.MATERIAL_ID, s.WHSLR_ID, w.REGION ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT DC_ID, WHSLR_ID, MATERIAL_ID, COUNT(*) n, SUM(UNITS) u FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002','FG-1003','FG-2001','FG-2002') AND SHIP_DT>='2026-07-02' GROUP BY DC_ID, WHSLR_ID, MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY 1,3,2
